description: This file defines an Express.js router for analytics-related endpoints, including health checks, cost metrics by agent, and new user statistics. It imports middleware, controller functions, and sets up various routes protected by authentication and tenant verification.

methods.name: head('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Health check endpoint for LLM cost by agent, returns 204 No Content with custom headers.

methods.name: options('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: Preflight OPTIONS request handler for LLM cost by agent, responds with 204 No Content.

methods.name: get('/llm-cost-by-agent')
methods.description: GET endpoint protected by authentication and tenant verification, retrieves LLM cost data by agent via controller.

methods.name: get('/users/new-over-time')
methods.description: GET endpoint protected by authentication and tenant verification, retrieves new users over time data via controller.
